7092.title: Stop loses cancellation before delayed Codex activation
7092.rootCauseOneLine: The native-start waiter expires after five seconds and Stop returns before session teardown, leaving no retained cancellation.
7092.proposedFix: Use the existing interrupted-boundary and session-release path for the specific pre-activation timeout; preserve other interrupt errors.
7092.caveats: Bridge reproduction verified twice; full live UI/status and real-provider frequency remain unverified. Reproduction code is embedded inline.
